title: Choose One Time email sender domain, from identity, and reply-to
exact_action_required: Provide sender domain, from email, sender display name, reply-to email, DNS authority, Resend account owner/path or alternate provider, and one approved test recipient.
guardrails: Do not invent a sender domain.
No live email send until sender/domain readiness passes and the exact SEND_RESEND_EMAIL confirmation phrase is supplied.
No Resend API key, webhook signing secret, DNS secret, secret screenshot, or raw private email body may be committed.
DNS tasks may store complete non-secret DNS record values copied from the provider dashboard; truncated screenshot values remain blocked.
